title: Modified Pechini-derived Na3V2(PO4)3/C with superior low-temperature performance for sodium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4567-4574
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08915H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ilyas Mukushev, Nurbolat Issatayev, Aliya Mukanova, Zhanar Jakupova, Zhumabay Bakenov, Kim Sung-Soo, Arailym Nurpeissova
NASICON-type Na3V2(PO4)3/C synthesized by a modified Pechini method shows excellent low-temperature performance for sodium-ion batteries, delivering 74.13 mAh g−1 at −20 °C (76.26% retention) and maintaining 74.99% capacity at −25 °C, demonstrating strong subzero resilience.
